order: Add a stop-grinding rule to the executor role and to the specialist template that inherits its structure, so an agent stops looping indefinitely trying to force a task to a finished state. Touch only agents/executor.md and agents/specialists/_TEMPLATE.md, confining the change to one line each. Outside that, nothing changes, and the diff should read as plain added lines, not a rewrite of the surrounding text. State the rule as a bounded number of implement-verify cycles: once that bound is reached without a clean pass, the agent must stop and report a partial result rather than push out a degraded status dressed up as done. PARTIAL never gets silently upgraded to DONE just because the cycle budget ran out. Keep the wording short enough to sit inline with the existing role text, and make sure both files carry the same rule, worded the same way.
claims: Both files now state the same stop-grinding rule inline: bounded implement-verify cycles, then stop and report a partial result rather than force a degraded done. The change lands across 2 files total — agents/executor.md and agents/specialists/_TEMPLATE.md — one inserted line apiece, no removed lines, no other lines touched. Verified by reading both files side by side to confirm the wording matches and by checking the diff stat shows no unrelated changes.
